changesProposed.name: Y Combinator

verified.name: Y Combinator
verified.thesis: Y Combinator invests $500,000 per company ($125,000 for 7% equity on a post-money SAFE and $375,000 on an uncapped SAFE with an MFN clause) in startups selected four times per year. Founders move to San Francisco for three months of intensive mentorship, office hours, and community support. The program aims to help startups achieve better products with more users and more options for raising capital.
verified.notes: Garry Tan became President and CEO in January 2023. Jared Friedman succeeded Michael Seibel as Managing Partner in March 2024. Headquarters relocated from Mountain View to San Francisco in spring 2023. Program runs four times per year (winter, spring, summer, fall). YC has launched more than 5,000 companies with over 400 worth more than $100M and 100 unicorns.
